question: Show revenue by region for 2024.
sql: SELECT r.name AS region, SUM(oi.quantity * oi.unit_price) AS value FROM order_items oi JOIN orders o ON o.order_id = oi.order_id JOIN customers c ON c.customer_id = o.customer_id JOIN regions r ON r.region_id = c.region_id WHERE strftime('%Y', o.order_date) = '2024' AND o.status = 'completed' GROUP BY r.name
